title: Lease Abstraction & Obligation Extraction

blueprintSignals.name: Field confidence
blueprintSignals.definition: calibrated probability that the extracted value is correct, per field type
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Calibrate by field type, as dates and amounts behave differently

blueprintSignals.name: Cross-document consistency
blueprintSignals.definition: difference between the rent in the abstract and the rent in the rent roll
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: The rent roll itself contains errors, so treat a mismatch as a question and not a verdict

blueprintSignals.name: Clause type classifier
blueprintSignals.definition: predicted clause class for each paragraph, such as rent review, break option or repair
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Clause wording varies between firms and jurisdictions, so test per template

blueprintSignals.name: Amendment ordering
blueprintSignals.definition: date order and reference chain linking each amendment to what it changes
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Missing pages and undated amendments break the chain and must be flagged

engineFeatures.meaning: capitalisation and digit pattern of a token
the words before and after, which carry the layout
where in the document the token sits

label: For "Lease Abstraction & Obligation Extraction": Read commercial leases and amendments and extract the dates, rents, options, break clauses and obligations into a structured abstract with page citations. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Evaluation on clean, modern leases hides failures on the old scans that dominate real portfolios.
